item.title: Displaced Students at Mira Costa
item.description: The LA fires displaced over 180,000 people and destroyed many schools. As of last week Mira Costa enrolled over 100 students affected by the fires. Emma Gordon and Makena King find out what the transition has been like for these students and Mira Costa teachers.

item.title: Ford Savela’s Passing and Celebration of Life
item.description: 3 weeks ago a hit and run driver killed Mira Costa senior Ford Savela and injured 2 others. Nathan Innoi and Piper Mundell have the latest facts about the case and how our community is reacting.

item.title: Privacy and Protection Online
item.description: Tik tok’s recent ban highlighted concerns over cyber security and privacy. But virtually every app and website you use could potentially leave you vulnerable to a security breach. Anya and Raquel find out what’s behind these online risks and how you can protect yourself.
